cases.name: factory-count
cases.source:
n := 0
fn(mk()) { n += 1; return x => x }
print([3,1,2].sort_by(mk()).stringify()); print(n)
print([3,1,2].map(mk()).stringify()); print(n)
print([].sort_by(mk()).stringify()); print(n)
print([].map(mk()).stringify()); print(n)

cases.name: factory-order
fresh-identity
cases.source:
f := x => x
g := x => x
print(f == g); print(f == f)

cases.name: escape-identities
capture-mutation
cases.source:
n := 0
f := x => n++
print([3,1,2].sort_by(f).stringify()); print(n)

cases.name: factory-capture-change
dynamic-capture-dependency
changing-outer
cases.source:
n := 1
f := x => x + n
print(f(2)); n = 7; print(f(2))

cases.name: shadowing
cases.source:
x := 99
f := x => x
print(f(3)); print(x)

cases.name: named-precedence
escaped-local-captures
cases.source:
fn(mk(v)) { return x => v }
a := mk(2); b := mk(8); print(a(0)); print(b(0))

cases.name: returned-callables
cases.source:
a := [2,7].map(x => (y => x))
f := a[0]; g := a[1]; print(f(0)); print(g(0)); print(f == g)

cases.name: root-path-growth
cases.source:
a := [[1]]
for(row : a) { f := x => row[0]; a.push([9]); print(f(0)) }

cases.name: unused-timer-observable
cases.source:
t := timer()
f := async x => x
r := f(3)
print(await r)
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/unused-timer-observable.f:3:6: async function capture contains a non-transferable timer

cases.name: async-invoke
cases.source:
f := async x => x + 1
r := f(3); print(await r)

cases.name: async-callback-current
cases.source:
f := async x => x + 1
print([3,1,2].sort_by(f).stringify())

cases.name: throwing-factory
bad-key-cleanup
cases.source:
try { [2,1].sort_by(x => [x]) } catch(e) { print("caught") }
print([2,1].sort_by(x => x).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/bad-key-cleanup.f:1:1: sort_by: key must be scalar

cases.name: module-ownership
compound-stable-ties
cases.source:
a := [{"n":"a","f":false,"v":2},{"n":"b","f":true,"v":1},{"n":"c","f":true,"v":3},{"n":"d","f":true,"v":3}]
print(a.sort_by(x => x.f, "desc", x => x.v, "desc").map(x => x.n).join(","))

cases.name: escaped-invoke-after-sort
nested-returned-factory
cases.source:
fn(mk(v)) { return y => (x => x + v + y) }
outer := mk(7); selector := outer(2); print([3,1,2].sort_by(selector).stringify()); print(selector(4))

cases.name: capture-rebinding-sort
location-parent-growth-sort
cases.source:
a := [{"k":1}]
for(row : a) { f := x => x * row.k; a.push({"k":-1}); print([3,1,2].sort_by(f).stringify()) }

cases.name: key-error-origin
cases.source:
fn(mk()) { return x => x.missing }
print([{"a":1}].sort_by(mk()).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/key-error-origin.f:2:7: lambda body error: value has no member: missing

cases.name: compound-factory-trace
cases.source:
fn(mk(n)) { print(n); return x => x }
print([2,1].sort_by(mk(1), "asc", mk(2), "desc").stringify())

cases.name: empty-factory-trace
cases.source:
fn(mk()) { print("factory"); return x => x }
print([].sort_by(mk()).stringify())

cases.name: bad-direction-origin
cases.source: print([3,1].sort_by(x => x, "sideways").stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/bad-direction-origin.f:1:7: sort_by: direction must be 'asc' or 'desc'

cases.name: compound-missing-direction
cases.source: print([3,1].sort_by(x => x, "asc", x => x).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/compound-missing-direction.f:1:7: sort_by: expected selector or selector/direction pairs

cases.name: module-definition-error
cases.source:
import("./error-module.f")
f := mk_error(); print([1].sort_by(f).stringify())
cases.stderr: error: <ORACLE_ROOT>/module-definition-error.f:2:24: lambda body error: value has no member: missing

cases.name: async-factory-sort
cases.source:
fn(mk()) { return async x => x + 1 }
print([3,1,2].sort_by(mk()).stringify())
